thread:
lydia_finance: FYI inbound from Helio Systems — their private deployment renewal includes a repeated platform fee line item. customer says they were charged platform fee twice for overlapping months. cc @rachel_account_mgr

tom_support: I pulled the invoice PDF (INV-2026-334). Looks like platform_fee $12,500 appears once under 'Renewal' and again under 'Add-ons' for the same period. They upgraded support tier mid-term which triggered an add-on fee, but it should have been prorated not duplicated.

rachel_account_mgr: Timeline: support upgrade requested 2026-03-05, change effective 2026-03-10. Renewal window starts 2026-03-01. They expected prorated support delta, not a full platform fee add-on.

price-bot: Note: pricing engine v2.0.1 had a known proration edge-case when change_effective_date < renewal_start_date. See PRICING-432.

lydia_finance: Can we produce a corrected invoice showing prorated add-on and a credit memo? Also need to confirm whether platform fee is refundable under the Private licensing T&Cs.

billing-bot: Retrieved invoice lines for INV-2026-334:
- PLATFEE_RENEWAL: $12,500
- SUPPORT_TIER_BASE: $8,000
- SUPPORT_TIER_ADDON: $12,500
- USAGE: $1,220

lydia_finance: If we prorate the SUPPORT_TIER_ADDON from 2026-03-10 to 2027-03-01 (for the remainder of that billing month) the refundable portion is $10,208.33. But customer says they were only expecting $2,500 difference.

rachel_account_mgr: They quote that internal procurement only approved the tier delta starting 3/10 and they have proof. We should offer a correction + a goodwill credit for the inconvenience. Suggest credit = max(prorated_amount - customer_paid, $2,500) capped at $12,500.

julia_cfo: Approve goodwill credit up to $5,000 for this account. Any credit beyond that needs escalation. Document the reason and include sign-off.

lydia_finance: Action items: 1) Billing team to issue credit memo CM-2026-089 for $10,208.33 flagged "provisional - under review". 2) Apply goodwill credit $5,000 as separate memo CM-2026-090. 3) Reissue corrected invoice INV-2026-334-R1 with combined credits and new total.

billing-bot: Created CM-2026-089 and CM-2026-090, status: pending_approval. Workflow requires finance lead approval and audit note.

price-bot: Recommend follow-up to engineering: fix proration logic path and add regression test for change_effective_date < renewal_start_date. Assign PRICING-432 back to eng-pricing.

tom_support: Notifying Helio with a short note and timeline:

"""
Hi Team Helio,

Thanks for flagging INV-2026-334. We found a proration bug that caused an added platform fee line to be applied in full instead of prorated. We're issuing credits and will send an adjusted invoice within 2 business days. Goodwill credit included. Sorry for the hassle.

Best, Rachel (Account team)
"""

lydia_finance: Logging this thread for audit. Will attach invoice diffs and ticket PRICING-432 to the credit memos. Closing once adjusted invoice confirmed.
